folds.text: Claude learned from text collected up to a certain date, called its **knowledge cutoff**. Anything newer is not in its head.
So it may not know about last week's news, a new phone, or the latest version of an app or tool.
When **web search** is available, Claude can look things up and read current pages. Without it, Claude only has what it learned.
For anything that changes, ask it to search, or tell it the version or date you mean. Then check the sources it gives.

folds.prompt: Does this need a web search, or can Claude just answer?
